context.transcript:
What do you think of using this cover photo on our website?
A. I can cover your shift.
B. In the file folder.
C. Sure, that looks great.
context.transcript_translation:
你觉得用这张封面照片放在我们的网站上怎么样？
A. 我可以替你值班。
B. 在文件夹里。
C. 当然，看起来很棒。

items.question: What do you think of using this cover photo on our website?
items.answer_explain: 原文依据：问句或陈述是“What do you think of using this cover photo on our website?”，自然应答是“Sure, that looks great.”。选择理由：该项在语义和会话功能上直接承接前句；其余选项只是词汇相关、时态不合或答非所问。正确答案：C（Sure, that looks great.）。
